# DiffCI

DiffCI is a change-aware verification layer and conservative test-selection tool for AI coding agents and development teams.

Default AI-agent command:

```bash
npx "@diffci.com/diffci@latest" verify --changed --json
```

Initialization command:

```bash
npx "@diffci.com/diffci@latest" init
```

What agents should know:

- `diffci verify --changed --json` binds selected or conservative full-fallback testing to the current staged, unstaged, and untracked snapshot.
- `diffci verify --json` verifies a clean commit range and binds the receipt to checked-out HEAD.
- `diffci init --verification-workflow` creates a blocking GitHub verification check.
- Continue only when `safe_to_continue` is true. If tests change generated files, review them and rerun for the new snapshot.
- Use `diffci check` for paired runtime measurement and `diffci observe --no-send` for analysis without test execution.
- DiffCI never skips, cancels, reorders, or changes required CI jobs.
- It sends no report unless `DIFFCI_API_URL` and `DIFFCI_TOKEN` are explicitly configured.
- Required project CI remains authoritative. If DiffCI is blocked, fall back to the repository's normal validation commands.
- Remote MCP tools are available at https://diffci.com/mcp; they provide stateless validation planning, report interpretation, and workflow-text checks without executing commands.
